# OmniGEO — Generative Engine Optimization & AI Citation Intelligence Platform
> Track, audit, and dominate your brand's visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and every AI search engine — in real-time.

## What is OmniGEO?
OmniGEO is the first Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) SaaS platform purpose-built for B2B companies, SaaS founders, and marketing agencies who want to monitor and improve how AI search engines recommend, cite, and rank their brand.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Model AI Citation Tracking**: Track brand mentions and citation positions across Perplexity Sonar, ChatGPT (GPT-4o), Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Google Gemini 2.0, and DeepSeek R1.
- **Technical GEO Crawler Audit Engine**: Audit any domain for robots.txt AI bot permissions, /llms.txt compliance, Schema.org JSON-LD presence, and semantic entity authority.
- **1-Click llms.txt & llms-full.txt Studio**: Generate spec-compliant /llms.txt files that help AI models understand and cite your product accurately.
- **Schema.org JSON-LD Generator**: Build SoftwareApplication, Organization, FAQPage, and WebSite schema markup with live code preview.
- **Competitor Share-of-Voice Radar**: Benchmark your AI citation share against up to 10 competitors with visual displacement analysis.
- **Prompt Tracking & Monitoring**: Track up to 350 commercial queries per month and monitor how AI models answer them over time.
- **Email Alert Center**: Get automated weekly/daily citation drop alerts and executive PDF reports via Resend API integration.
- **White-Label Executive Reports**: Print-ready branded PDF reports for agency clients with full citation matrices.

## Pricing
- **Starter Framework**: $29/month — 1 workspace, 25 tracked queries, weekly monitoring.
- **Pro Growth Framework**: $79/month — 3 workspaces, 100 tracked queries, daily multi-model monitoring, competitor radar.
- **Agency & Scale Framework**: $199/month — 10 workspaces, 350 tracked queries, white-label reports, all 5 AI models.

## BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) Architecture
OmniGEO uses a BYOK model. Users provide their own OpenRouter, OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini API keys. All AI queries execute client-side with $0 platform markup. OmniGEO sells the software framework, algorithms, and monitoring tools — not API inference.

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite
- Auth & Database: Firebase Auth + Cloud Firestore
- Payments: Dodo Payments (Stripe-compatible)
- Edge Backend: Cloudflare Workers
- Email Alerts: Resend API
